description: Implementation of the ‘Surakimu Lanka’ National Energy Security Mission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The country's energy security has been challenged by factors such as dependence on fossil fuels for energy supply, unpredictable dry weather conditions, periodic disruptions in fuel supply due to geopolitical instability, and fluctuations in fuel prices in the international market. It has been recognized that the additional pressure on the national economy caused by the rising cost of fuel imports, together with all these factors, may further aggravate due to the irregular electricity consumption pattern of electricity consumers. Therefore, in order to properly manage the situation, it has been identified that behavioral changes of the general public are also essential to shift electricity consumption to periods with high renewable energy generation and to enhance the efficiency of energy consumption. In order to achieve the said objectives, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to implement a joint program called the 'Surakimu Lanka' National Energy Security Mission, led by the Presidential Secretariat, the Ministry of Energy, the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority, the Clean Sri Lanka Secretariat, and with the participation of all Government Institutions, state corporations and statutory boards, the private sector and the general public.
